title.narrative: Programa Urbano de Bienestar para la Niez en Extrema Pobreza - Fase I
Urban Welfare Program for Children in Extreme Poverty - Phase I

description.narrative: Ampliar el acceso con calidad a intervenciones comunitarias, inclusivas y sostenibles de atencin integral a las y los menores de seis aos as como a sus familias y comunidades en barrios urbanos priorizados por su nivel de pobreza, a fin de contribuir a mejorar el desarrollo integral de la niez que vive en condiciones de extrema pobreza en el rea urbana.

The objective of the program is to expand quality access to inclusive and sustainable community interventions for providing comprehensive care to children under six and their families and communities in urban areas accorded priority on account of their level of poverty, in an effort to help improve the comprehensive development of children living in extreme poverty in urban areas.
